name: fix-authority-server-reachability-status
title: Fix control-plane readiness when status endpoint is unreachable
description: When the configured control service URL is unreachable, status should report unreachable and stop claiming ready.

events.reason: Superseded by Authority Server removal: this old control-plane reachability story modifies authority-client/autopilot-authority surfaces that are no longer part of the core Proofbound path, so merging it would reintroduce retired semantics.
